label: Glass Slab (WebGL)
description: A true 3D glass pane rendered in WebGL (three.js): a beveled slab with a glowing edge and a real specular that shifts with rotation. It begins edge-on -- you see its lit glass thickness in a black void -- then rotates continuously through 90 degrees to reveal the UI screenshot on its face, with real bloom on the glowing edges. Photoreal Framer/Apple-style product reveal. Provide screenshot (image URL) and an aspect_ratio matching it. Best on pure black. Heavier to render than the CSS edge-lit-slab.

screenshot.label: Screenshot / UI image URL for the glass face

aspect_ratio.label: Face aspect ratio (W / H) -- match the screenshot

glow_color.label: Edge glow / glass tint color (hex). Defaults to brand primary.

caption.label: Optional lower caption that fades in late
